name: Clamped_LC_Filtered_SSHI
rationale: To meet the strict ripple requirement (20 mV) without failing the startup time (0.15 s), I cannot simply increase Cout. Instead, I am placing a Zener clamp (Dz) at the rectifier output (n_rect) BEFORE the LC filter (L_filt, Cout). This configuration converts the pulsed current from the rectifier into a more constant current flow through the inductor, significantly reducing the ripple at the output node 'out' while maintaining a fast startup since the inductor's series resistance is low.
